text:
evan: Heads-up — RFC review slots for Thurs 3pm. Need to lock ordering and who’s primed for pre-reads. Can folks confirm availability?

rachel: I can take the 3:00–3:15 slot if needed, will prep slides and a 1-page summary.

kevin: I’m on for reviewing, but I have a calendar conflict from 3:20–3:40. If we can put my review earlier that’d help.

maria: I can do 3:15–3:30. Bringing the metrics for cache serialization RFC. Will drop pre-read in the doc tonight.

daniel: I’m out Thu afternoon. If someone wants to swap with me, I can take Fri morning.

sara: I’ll be reviewer for the infra autoscaling RFC. Prefer a later slot (3:30+) so I have time after standup.

matt: Quick Q — do we want the slot order to be: small quick PRs first, then the larger design RFCs? That'd make time for discussions.

ev an: I like that ordering. Proposed agenda (short):
```
1) Quick sync & goals (5m)
2) Two fast followups / small ops RFCs (15m)
3) Deep design reviews (30m)
4) Action items & owners (10m)
```

rachel: That looks good. Note: authors should paste a 3-bullet pre-read at top of the doc. Makes reviews faster.

kevin: I can move up to 3:05 if evan or rachel can swap by 10am tomorrow. @maria can you confirm your pre-read link?

maria: Posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/rfc/cache-serialization — summary at top, perf graphs in appendix.

ci-bot: Reminder — RFC review doc check: please add reviewers in the doc template by EOD.

daniel: @matt I can swap to your Fri slot. Thanks for the heads-up.

ev an: OK final tentative order: 3:00 quick ops (rachel), 3:05 reviewer kevin, 3:15 cache-serialization (maria), 3:30 infra autoscaling (sara), then open time. If anyone needs swaps speak up by 10am tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sara: Ack — I’ll add my pre-read TL;DR.

matt: Thanks — marking calendar and adding the agenda to the meeting thread.

kevin: One last ask — can authors include one sentinel prompt or test case that demonstrates the expected behavior? Saves time during review.

rachel: Good call. I’ll add one.

ev an: Great — if no objections I’ll send an updated invite + agenda at 10:15. :wave:
